description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an API / Integration Developer, IFCAP (SCM DSO) based in the United States.
We are seeking an experienced API / Integration Developer to support the development, maintenance, and modernization of enterprise integrations within a mission-critical federal healthcare technology environment. In this remote role, you will build and sustain REST APIs, microservices, and interfaces connecting financial, procurement, logistics, and supply chain platforms. Your work will help ensure reliable data exchange between essential systems supporting purchasing, inventory management, and financial operations across VA medical centers. You will collaborate with developers, architects, cybersecurity specialists, and technical teams to maintain secure, scalable, and interoperable solutions. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to meaningful modernization initiatives while supporting technology that directly serves veterans and healthcare professionals.

Accountabilities:
 
 You will be responsible for developing and sustaining API-driven integrations, ensuring the reliability and security of interfaces connecting IFCAP with key enterprise platforms. You will also support production operations, troubleshoot technical issues, and contribute to continuous improvement and modernization initiatives.


 
 
 
 Develop, maintain, and enhance REST APIs, microservices, and enterprise integrations supporting IFCAP.







 
 
 
 Sustain item-master microservices and interfaces connecting IFCAP with iFAMS, VALIP, and MuleSoft.







 
 
 
 Collaborate with VistA/MUMPS developers and technical teams to support system integration and data exchange.







 
 
 
 Support production systems and external consumers using IFCAP APIs and integration services.







 
 
 
 Analyze and document business logic, interface requirements, and data exchange processes.







 
 
 
 Design and maintain secure, reliable, and scalable integration solutions.







 
 
 
 Manage interface security configurations, including service accounts, certificates, and token-based authentication.







 
 
 
 Monitor interface availability, performance, and transaction processing to identify potential issues.







 
 
 
 Investigate and resolve production incidents, integration failures, connectivity issues, and data processing errors.







 
 
 
 Perform regression testing following changes to integration platforms and connected systems.







 
 
 
 Develop and maintain automated interface tests to ensure reliability and compatibility.







 
 
 
 Implement security updates and remediate vulnerabilities identified through application security scanning.







 
 
 
 Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to address security findings and maintain compliance.







 
 
 
 Support special projects and modernization initiatives requiring IFCAP integration services.







 
 
 
 Coordinate with architects, developers, testers, and configuration management teams during software releases.







 
 
 
 Maintain technical documentation, including API specifications, interface contracts, operational runbooks, and known issues.







 
 
 
 Participate in Agile development activities, code reviews, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement initiatives.








 Requirements :

 The ideal candidate has at least five years of experience developing and supporting REST APIs, microservices, and enterprise integrations. You should bring strong technical knowledge of API architecture, integration patterns, interface security, and production support, along with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.


 
 
 
 Minimum of five years of experience developing, implementing, or sustaining REST APIs and microservices.







 
 
 
 Experience designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise system integrations.







 
 
 
 Experience with integration platforms such as MuleSoft or comparable middleware technologies.







 
 
 
 Strong understanding of RESTful services, API architecture, and enterprise integration patterns.







 
 
 
 Experience implementing interface security, including certificates, service accounts, and token-based authentication.







 
 
 
 Experience supporting production APIs and integration services, including monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident response.







 
 
 
 Experience developing and executing automated regression tests for APIs and system interfaces.







 
 
 
 Ability to identify and resolve integration failures, connectivity issues, and data processing errors.







 
 
 
 Understanding of application security practices and vulnerability remediation.







 
 
 
 Experience documenting API specifications, interface contracts, and technical integration requirements.







 
 
 
 Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.







 
 
 
 Ability to collaborate effectively with developers, architects, cybersecurity teams, testers, and technical leadership.







 
 
 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.







 
 
 
 Ability to obtain and maintain a Tier 2 / Moderate Risk Public Trust background investigation and VA identity credential.








 Preferred Qualifications:


 
 
 
 Experience integrating with VA VistA applications, InterSystems IRIS, or HealthShare.







 
 
 
 Experience supporting VA financial, procurement, or supply chain systems, particularly IFCAP or iFAMS.







 
 
 
 Familiarity with the VA Logistics Integration Platform (VALIP) or similar enterprise integration environments.







 
 
 
 Experience with Red Hat OpenShift, Red Hat 3scale API Management, or Apache Kafka.







 
 
 
 Experience developing or maintaining item-master microservices and enterprise data integrations.







 
 
 
 Familiarity with cloud-based integration platforms and microservices architectures.







 
 
 
 Experience supporting API security, certificate management, and enterprise authentication mechanisms.







 
 
 
 Experience working within Agile development teams using Jira, Git, or similar tools.







 
 
 
 MuleSoft or cloud platform certification.







 
 
 
 Experience supporting Department of Veterans Affairs or other federal healthcare IT programs.







 
 
 
 Active or recent VA background investigation and identity credential.








 Benefits: 


 
 
 
 Annual salary range of $80,000–$140,000, depending on skills, qualifications, experience, and location.







 
 
 
 Potential eligibility for additional compensation, such as bonuses, depending on the position.







 
 
 
 Remote working options within the United States, subject to VA approval.







 
 
 
 Above-industry healthcare benefits.







 
 
 
 Paid time off and paid holidays.







 
 
 
 Healthcare Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA).







 
 
 
 Paid life insurance.







 
 
 
 Short-term and long-term disability coverage.







 
 
 
 401(k) matching.







 
 
 
 Tuition reimbursement.







 
 
 
 Training and certification opportunities.







 
 
 
 Employee Assistance Program.







 
 
 
 Military leave.







 
 
 
 Occasional travel within the continental United States may be required.
